intro.title: FUNDA — Smart Truncate Pipe
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Smart Truncate Pipe — a configurable pure pipe that shortens long text strings to a specified character limit and appends a customisable suffix (e.g., "…" or "read more"). You will then extend it into an impure variant that reacts to window resize events, truncating to a shorter limit on mobile viewports. By building both variants you will deeply understand what pure and impure mean in Angular's change detection context.
intro.usecase: Pipes are Angular's built-in memoisation for templates: pure pipes re-run only when their input reference changes. Custom pipes appear in news feeds, product catalogues, notification lists, and dashboards.
